name: outfit-weather
description: What to wear today or tomorrow in any city, from a whole-day forecast averaged over three weather models.

interface.shortDescription: What to wear today, from a precise whole-day forecast
interface.longDescription: Ask what to wear in any city today or tomorrow. Outfit Weather looks at the whole day from morning to evening: temperature, feels-like, rain, snow and wind, averaged from three weather models (ECMWF, ICON, GFS), and shows a neon card with the outfit.
defaultPrompt: Use Outfit Weather: what should I wear tomorrow in Bishkek?
Use Outfit Weather: what should I wear today in Paris?
